rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE NATIONAL GERIATRIC HEALTH CENTRE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: Dona Eva Macaraeg-acapagal National Geriatric Health Centre Act
rows.abstract: “Dona Eva Macaraeg-Macapagal National Geriatric Health Centre Act.” Seeks to create a hospital known as National Geriatric Health Center which will focus on the medical needs of senior citizens so that they will have the comfort and assurance that the government is truly concerned for their well-being. The hospital will be having the nature of a corporate body, which render the medical institution more viable and more responsive to the varied demands of patients, whose benefits and facilities are open not only to Manilans but to all Filipinos through the land.

rows.title_short: Pregnant And Parenting Students Services Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: “Pregnant and Parenting Students Services Act Of 2009.” Seeks to mandate the Department of Education to enlist the participation of the educational institutions in teaching our students the value of responsible parenting. By doing so, we will not only help our unfortunate student parents but we will also be able to prevent such unfortunate incidents from proliferating in our campuses.

rows.title_short: Tree For Legacy Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: Seeks to enhance public awareness and participation on environmental restoration and protection; encourage the participation of the public and private civil society  in the reforestation program of the government; generate incetives and additional sources of income and livelihood without impairing the ecological balance or our natural resources; reduce poverty incidence in the uplands; cover available lands possible, including but not limited to, the protection and production of forest lands and private lands; and accelerate the implementation of reforestation programs with minimal government assistance.

rows.abstract: “Taxi Passenger Bill of Rights Act.” Aims to protect the commuting public, citizen and tourists alike from predatory practices of some taxi drivers and operators. It also seeks to acknowledge the rights of taxi passengers and penalizes both driver and the operator of the taxi cab who violate these rights.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2009-05-06

rows.abstract: Seeks to create an advisory panel on Autism and Immune Deficiency Disorders in Infants and Toddlers within the Department of Health. Through this panel, the causes of Autism and other disorders that becomes manifested during childhood will be identified thus preventive measures will be institutionalized. The knowledge that will be gained through this comprehensive approach will benefit not only our country but also worldwide scientific community as well.

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE USE OF HIGH INTENSITY DISCHARGE HEADLAMPS IN MOTOR VEHICLES
rows.title_short: Hid Regulation Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: “HID Regulation Act of 2009.” Aims to limit the use of HID headlamps to vehicles with headlamp housing originally designed for HID use, and not those designed for conventional halogen or tungsten for the reason that the former design (retrofitted headlamps) have been known to cause accidents on the road and have generally inconvenienced those who drive at night.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2009-05-06

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GRANT PROGRAM TO ENHANCE FINANCIAL AND RETIREMENT LITERACY FOR MID-LIFE AND OLDER FILIPINOS
rows.title_short: Retirement Security Education Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: “Retirement Security Education Act of 2009.” Seeks to establish a grant program to enhance financial and retirement literacy for mid-life and older Filipinos so that fraud against older individuals, including telemarketing schemes, predatory lending, identity theft and Internet fraud that rose dramatically be abated if not totally eliminated.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECONOMIC AFFAIRS since 2009-05-06

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION TO CREATE EDUCATIONAL PROGRAMS TO RAISE AWARENESS OF EATING DISORDERS AMONG FILIPINO CHILDREN
rows.title_short: Eating Disorders Awareness, Prevention, And Education  Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: “Eating Disorders Awareness, Prevention, and Education  Act of 2009.” Seeks to provide local districts and parents with the means and flexibility to improve awareness of, identify, and help students with eating disorders to ensure that such individuals receive a high-quality education thereby securing their chance for a bright future.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2009-05-06

rows.author: D077
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING REFORMS IN LAND ADMINISTRATION
rows.title_short: The Land Administration Reform Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"The Land Administration Reform Act Of 2009.\" Seeks to integrate all land administration functions currently disperswed among multiple agencies into a single agency and to enable the lands sector to contribute to economic growth and poverty alleviation.
rows.status: Measure reconsidered on 2009-06-01

rows.author: F079
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING A MECHANISM FOR FREE LEGAL ASSISTANCE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Legal Assistance Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: “Legal Assistance Act of 2009.” Seeks to provide mechanism that guarantee free legal assistance to the poor and ensure that every person who cannot afford the services of a counsel is provided with a competent independent counsel preferably of his/her own choice.
rows.status: Consolidated into HB04301

rows.author: F079
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMOTING BARANGAY JUSTICE BY AMENDING ARTICLE ELEVEN HUNDRED FIFTY-FIVE OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED THREE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-SIX, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CIVIL CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Seeks to address the need to strengthen the system of amicably settling disputes at the barangay level by specifically providing that the filing of a case with the Punong Barangay interrupts the running of the prescriptive period under the Civil Code of the Philippines or RA No. 386, particularly Article 1155. The suspension, however, does not extend to more than sixty (60) days to prevent the possibility of undue delay that the suspension may engender.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-05-11

rows.author: F079
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROTECTING PRIVATE PROPERTY RIGHTS BY REQUIRING GOVERNMENT AGENCIES TO PREPARE PRIVATE PROPERTY TAKING IMPACT ANALYSIS
rows.title_short: Private Property Rights Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: “Private Property Rights Act of 2009.” Seeks to protect private property rights by requiring government agencies to prepare private property impact analyses before said property is taken for public use. This is important to guide agency actions, including regulations, not to overstep the clear boundaries set by the Constitution concerning private property.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2009-05-11

rows.author: F079
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO STRENGTHEN THE OFFICE OF THE GOVERNMENT CORPORATE COUNSEL BY RE-DEFINING, EXPANDING, STRENGTHENING, RATIONALIZING AND FURTHER PROFESSIONALIZING ITS ORGANIZATION, UPGRADING EMPLOYEE BENEFITS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to re-define and strengthen the mandate of the Office of the Government Corporate Counsel (OGCC) by streamlining, further professionalizing and rationalizing its functions and organization.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2009-05-11

rows.author: F079
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 2 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 4103, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE INDETERMINATE SENTENCE LAW
rows.abstract: Seeks to amend Republic Act No. 4103, also known as the Intermediate Sentence Law, in order to include criminal offenses against minors in the enumeration of certain crimes to which the provisions of the Act do not apply.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-05-11

rows.author: F079
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT RA10071 (Lapsed into law on 2010-04-08)
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONSTITUTING THE NATIONAL PROSECUTION SERVICE INTO AN AUTONOMOUS OFFICE OF THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Prosecution Service Autonomy Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: “Prosecution Service Autonomy Act of 2009.\" Democracy will not fully blossom unless the rule of law is put in place. To ensure rule of law, it is essential that the Prosecution Service is backed up by the trust of the people. This bill seeks to do so by strengthening the independence of the National Prosecution Services - free from interference of politicians, high-ranking government officials and businessmen. It aims to strengthen public trust toward the Prosecution Service and, in the process, help advance democracy in the Philippines.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07112

rows.author: F079
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SPECIAL HOSPITAL FOR OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS (OFWs) AND THEIR DEPENDENTS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2009-05-11

rows.author: F079
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING PHILIPPINE DISASTER RISK MANAGEMENT CAPABILITY BY INSTITUTIONALIZING THE NATIONAL DISASTER RISK MANAGEMENT FRAMEWORK, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Philippine Disaster Risk Management Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Disaster Risk Management Act of 2009.” Seeks to establish the National Disaster Mangement Council which shall be tasked to develop, formulate and implement a National Disaster Risk Management Plan (NDRMP) in conformity with a National Disaster Risk Management Framework (NDRMF) for creating a comprehensive and community-based disaster risk management approach, which shall be anticipatory of and responsive to socio-economic and environmental impacts of disasters. It encompases all actions and measures pertaining to all aspects of disaster management from pre-disaster phase to post-disaster phase. Further it proposes to enhance national leadership, strengthen local capabilities, mainstream disaster risk planning, improve risk communication, enhance accountability and financial supports.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06985

rows.author: F014
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE LEGITIMATION OF CHILDREN BORN TO PARENTS WHO ARE BELOW MARRYING AGE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Nowadays the incidents of children born out of wedlock to parents who are disqualified under the law to marry each other because of the issue of minority is almost an everyday occurrence. It is in the light of the foregoing that in the amendment of the provision of the Family Code is earnestly sought in order to uphold the rights of children as well as their human dignity.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-05-11

rows.author: F039
rows.title_full: BATAS NA MANGANGASIWA SA AWTORIDAD NG KOMISYON SA ELEKSIYON (COMELEC) UPANG GANAP AT DIREKTANG HUMAWAK NG KONTROL AT PANGANGASIWA KAUGNAY NG PAGSASAGAWA NG ELEKSIYON SA MGA KINAUUKULANG POLITIKAL NA DIBISYON, YUNIT O LUGAR AT SA IBA PANG LAYUNIN (AN ACT TO GOVERN THE COMMISSION ON ELECTIONS' AUTHORITY TO TAKE FULL AND DIRECT CONTROL AND SUPERVISION RELATIVE TO THE CONDUCT OF ELECTIONS IN POLITICAL DIVISIONS, UNITS OR AREAS OF CONCERN, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES)
rows.title_short: Comelec Control Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: “Comelec Control Act of 2009.” Layunin ng panukalang batas na tukuyin ang mga pagkakataon kung kailan maaaring ipatupad ang pag-control ng isang lugar ng COMELEC upang matiyak ang malinis at mapayapang election. Inililista rin nito ang mga kapangyarihan at tungkulin  ng Komisyon sa pagdiriin ng gayong kontrol, sa pagsusulong ng layunin nito upang maiwasan ang mga karanasan at pandaraya kaugnay ng eleksyon.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2009-05-11
